topic: Realtime data access for new companies
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the activation and visibility of real-time analytics data for newly added companies. It was noted that while real-time functionality is generally expected to work for all, specific checks revealed missing records in key tables (e.g., `device_session_facility`, `device_session_trusted`, `facility_dict`). The issue appears related to the process of adding new company data, particularly when routers are involved.

It was confirmed that real-time functionality is generally active and likely implemented via a cascade of views (e.g., referencing `raw_device_seen` or similar logic).
decisions: Real-time analytics access for new companies needs verification.
